title: Magic literals (account_id, ids, state names) repeated across smoke tests
description:
Across the three smoke-test files:
- "A13824" appears ~26 times (should be helpers::TEST_ACCOUNT_ID)
- "s1"/"r1" appear 26 times each (envelope helper would eliminate)
- "chat-1" 8 occurrences, "msg-1" ~15 occurrences, "sp-1" repeatedly
- 20+ distinct state-literal styles ("c-old", "c-new", "sp-old", "qs-old", "qs-new", "mc-old", "mc-new"...) where one before_state/after_state pair per file would suffice
- UTCDate literals ("2024-06-15T09:00:00Z", etc.) scattered without shared definition

Consolidate into tests/helpers.rs constants. Mostly a follow-on to JMAP-26di.11 (boilerplate dedup).
